description: This source file defines a set of enums, structs, and functions for transcoding JPEG images in Swift. It includes error handling, image resizing, quality adjustment, and image encoding functionalities, primarily using CoreGraphics and ImageIO frameworks.

classes.name: JPEGTranscodeError
classes.description: Enumeration defining possible errors during JPEG transcoding, conforming to LocalizedError and Sendable.

classes.name: JPEGTranscoder
classes.description: Struct providing static methods to transcode images to JPEG format, with options for quality, size, and byte size constraints.

methods.name: clampQuality
methods.description: Clamps the input quality value between 0.05 and 1.0.

methods.name: transcodeToJPEG
methods.description: Main function to re-encode image data to JPEG, optionally downscaling to fit within maxWidthPx and maxBytes constraints, normalizing EXIF orientation.
